def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(h):
        row=g[r]
        for c in range(w):
            if row[c]!=0: continue
            L=next((row[c2] for c2 in range(c-1,-1,-1) if row[c2]!=0),None)
            R=next((row[c2] for c2 in range(c+1,w) if row[c2]!=0),None)
            if L is not None and L==R: out[r][c]=L
    # last band row = last row containing a nonzero
    last=max(r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][c]!=0 for c in range(w)) )
    for c in range(w):
        col=[g[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        nz=[r for r in range(h) if col[r]!=0]
        if not nz: continue
        blocks=[]; s=nz[0]; p=nz[0]
        for r in nz[1:]:
            if r==p+1: p=r
            else: blocks.append((s,p)); s=r; p=r
        blocks.append((s,p))
        for (a,b) in blocks:
            if a>last:  # marker below the bottom band
                mcol=col[a]
                band=None
                for r in range(a-1,-1,-1):
                    if out[r][c]!=0: band=r; break
                if band is not None:
                    bandcolor=out[band][c]
                    for r in range(band):
                        if out[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=bandcolor
                    for r in range(band+1,h):
                        if out[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=mcol
    return out
